inductive TmF : Type
  | lit  : Int -> TmF
  | tvar : Nat -> TmF
  | add  : TmF -> TmF -> TmF
  | mul  : TmF -> TmF -> TmF
  | app  : Nat -> TmF -> TmF

def evalTmF (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int) : TmF -> Int
  | TmF.lit n   => n
  | TmF.tvar k  => env k
  | TmF.add a b => evalTmF fenv env a + evalTmF fenv env b
  | TmF.mul a b => evalTmF fenv env a * evalTmF fenv env b
  | TmF.app f a => fenv f (evalTmF fenv env a)

def substTmF (k : Nat) (t : TmF) : TmF -> TmF
  | TmF.lit n   => TmF.lit n
  | TmF.tvar j  => if j = k then t else TmF.tvar j
  | TmF.add a b => TmF.add (substTmF k t a) (substTmF k t b)
  | TmF.mul a b => TmF.mul (substTmF k t a) (substTmF k t b)
  | TmF.app f a => TmF.app f (substTmF k t a)

theorem evalTmF_app (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int)
    (f : Nat) (a : TmF) :
    evalTmF fenv env (TmF.app f a) = fenv f (evalTmF fenv env a) := rfl

theorem substTmF_app (k : Nat) (t : TmF) (f : Nat) (a : TmF) :
    substTmF k t (TmF.app f a) = TmF.app f (substTmF k t a) := rfl

inductive PdF : Type
  | peq  : TmF -> TmF -> PdF
  | ple  : TmF -> TmF -> PdF
  | pand : PdF -> PdF -> PdF
  | pimp : PdF -> PdF -> PdF

def denoteF (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int) : PdF -> Prop
  | PdF.peq a b  => evalTmF fenv env a = evalTmF fenv env b
  | PdF.ple a b  => evalTmF fenv env a <= evalTmF fenv env b
  | PdF.pand p q => denoteF fenv env p /\ denoteF fenv env q
  | PdF.pimp p q => denoteF fenv env p -> denoteF fenv env q

instance decDenoteF (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int) :
    (p : PdF) -> Decidable (denoteF fenv env p)
  | PdF.peq a b =>
      inferInstanceAs (Decidable (evalTmF fenv env a = evalTmF fenv env b))
  | PdF.ple a b =>
      inferInstanceAs (Decidable (evalTmF fenv env a <= evalTmF fenv env b))
  | PdF.pand p q => by
      haveI := decDenoteF fenv env p
      haveI := decDenoteF fenv env q
      exact inferInstanceAs (Decidable (denoteF fenv env p /\ denoteF fenv env q))
  | PdF.pimp p q => by
      haveI := decDenoteF fenv env p
      haveI := decDenoteF fenv env q
      exact inferInstanceAs (Decidable (denoteF fenv env p -> denoteF fenv env q))

def checkF (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int) (p : PdF) : Bool :=
  decide (denoteF fenv env p)

theorem checkF_sound (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int) (p : PdF)
    (h : checkF fenv env p = true) : denoteF fenv env p :=
  of_decide_eq_true h

theorem checkF_sound_app (fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int) (env : Nat -> Int)
    (f : Nat) (a : TmF) (c : Int)
    (h : checkF fenv env (PdF.peq (TmF.app f a) (TmF.lit c)) = true) :
    fenv f (evalTmF fenv env a) = c :=
  checkF_sound fenv env _ h
candidates.origin: ROUND 2 for refusal-function-symbol, driven by round 1's PASSED verdict (p8-parallel-tower-r1, consumed in results/reflect_p8_round1_consumption.md). A PASS carries a null `detail` BY DESIGN, so there is no transcript to drive from; the PASSED rule says to EXTEND the prototype toward the next requirement the row's class measurement still names as unmet, and tests/test_function_symbol_class.py names exactly one. Finding (4) and test_a_function_symbol_forces_a_constructor_and_a_decidable_story (lines ~653-681) price the rung at TWO costs: (i) an APPLICATION NODE, which r1 met -- TmF's `app : Nat -> TmF -> TmF` plus the second environment `fenv : Nat -> Int -> Int` the assertion says the committed Tm has nowhere to put -- and (ii) a new DECIDABLE STORY, in the measurement's own words: `decDenote decides every Pd BY COMPUTATION over evalTm, and an uninterpreted symbol constrained only by axioms has no computable value -- so the rung would owe a new Decidable story as well, not merely a new case`. THIS ROUND TAKES (ii) AND ONLY (ii): r1's text is carried forward VERBATIM (the splice appends after the committed slice, so nothing r1 declared is available unless it is re-declared here) and exactly one requirement is added on top, so a regression is attributable to the addition rather than to the carry. The addition is the predicate layer over TmF -- PdF with both connectives, denoteF, the decDenoteF instance, checkF, checkF_sound -- plus the tooth checkF_sound_app, a `true` from the checker on an equation whose LEFT SIDE IS AN APPLICATION, discharged by checkF_sound alone. That tooth is the whole point: it is decidability reaching THROUGH the new constructor rather than around it, which is what an unexercised instance would look like. WHAT THIS SETTLES AND WHAT IT EMPHATICALLY DOES NOT. It settles that an application node does not BY ITSELF destroy the computational Decidable story -- PROVIDED the symbol is INTERPRETED by a computable fenv, which is the route this tower takes. It does NOT refute the measurement, and must not be read as doing so: the measurement's `no computable value` claim is about the AXIOM-ONLY route -- a symbol constrained by hypotheses alone -- and that route is the shape the row's actual subjects present (the recurrences a_n/d_n/F_n at a SYMBOLIC index, where there is no computable fenv to supply). So what r2 delimits is the cost, not the verdict: the Decidable story is OWED and here is what one looks like on the interpreted route; the axiom-only route still has no computable value, and that is precisely why refusal-function-symbol stays definitional-extension and attended-only under PLAN_FRAGMENT 3.1 rule 3. Nothing here revises the row's class verdict, its OPEN status, or its measured five-subject ceiling (finding (1): six of the eleven blocking refusals are held independently by symbolic-exponent, and a function-symbol mechanism bought alone returns none of those six). Still a PARALLEL tower appended after the committed slice (the splice constraint: Tm and Pd cannot be extended from an append), still a PROPOSAL and never a slice edit -- tools/FgReflect.lean has no write path from this file, and adopting anything that passes is an attended purchase decision under the ordinary bill discipline.
